listing.name: Super Smash Bros. Ultimate (ssbu-recomp)
listing.summary: This experimental Windows port of Super Smash Bros. Ultimate builds locally from your own 13.0.4 or 13.0.5 game. The project reports a scripted CPU match and one Linux match. Physical controllers and matches with three or more players remain unconfirmed.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use your own 13.0.4 or 13.0.5 game dump and keys. Apply any owned updates or DLC locally. The project includes open-source fonts and requires no separate firmware.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Follow the Windows 10 or 11 x64 source guide and run the project’s Install SSBU.bat, which downloads its Python environment, player and build tools. A source ZIP or clone is required.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: World of Light reaches its intro. Online play and rollback are experimental. The reported Linux match used CachyOS, an NVIDIA GPU and Wayland. Steam Deck play remains untested.
